scope.title: Scope
scope.description: Choose a scope to limit which rows can trigger the flow

filteringattributes.title: Select columns
filteringattributes.description: Enter a comma-separated list of column unique names. The flow triggers if any of the columns is present in the update payload regardless of if data is modified

filterexpression.title: Filter rows
filterexpression.description: Odata expression to limit rows that can trigger the flow, eg. statecode eq 0

postponeuntil.title: Delay until
postponeuntil.description: Enter a time to delay the trigger evaluation, eg. 2020-01-01T10:10:00Z

runas.title: Run as
runas.description: Choose the running user for steps where invoker connections are used

name.title: Name
name.description: Callback registration name. Value will be replaced with workflow id

cat_agentname.title: Agent / opportunity name
cat_agentname.description: The working name of the agent or opportunity, used to identify it in conversation and on the backlog.

cat_status.title: Approval status
cat_status.description: The CoE decision on the request.

cat_buildstatus.title: Build status
cat_buildstatus.description: Where the build has reached once approved.

cat_department.title: Business area
cat_department.description: The part of the organisation the request comes from.

cat_decisioncomments.title: Comments shared with requester
cat_decisioncomments.description: Requester-facing CoE comments included in approval and rejection emails. Do not enter internal-only notes.
